method.route_order: Alternate Mysuru/article first position on odd/even rounds.
method.primary_arm_order: Use a predetermined balanced schedule of all six three-arm permutations, then repeat three rotations so each primary arm occupies each sample position three times.
method.A_A_repeat: Nine additional A-repeat samples on Mysuru. Each is adjacent to that round's primary A sample; the A-repeat is placed before/after A on alternating rounds.
method.performance_model: Lighthouse mobile simulated run; effective Lighthouse throttling settings are retained per sample.
method.resource_delivery: Local PHP-WASM-rendered HTML and selected-arm local assets, plus pinned npm mirrors for fonts and scene scripts. Unsupported external requests are blocked. No production host or live network is measured.
method.interpretation: Simulated local evidence only. Not PageSpeed Insights, field data, production/CDN timing, deployment proof or a live-speed claim.

samples.metric_source: Lighthouse mobile simulated run. Values are raw per-sample audit results; no summary or budget pass/fail is computed here.
